skill.name: Commit/Explore
skill.strategic_description: Commits from the STUNA AREA intro/playfield into active gameplay, spawning enemies/projectiles and HUD elements while removing intro/title and transitional scene objects.

steps: Detect whether the environment is still in entry mode
Choose the transition action that starts active interaction
Execute the transition into the main interactive state
Confirm active elements appear and introductory elements disappear
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

contract.name: Probe Controls
contract.description: Tap one direction/fire briefly to test how Space Harrier II responds before committing to a full dodge or attack lane. Use this right after a new wave or when control timing feels unclear to safely map movement speed and shot behavior.

skill.name: Inspect/Setup
skill.strategic_description: Initial setup/inspection leaves the player and STUNA AREA screen in place while registering appearance/disappearance events for scene elements (sky, ground, horizon, and another prior entity).

steps: Observe the current scene while keeping the baseline state unchanged
Select key regions or elements relevant for initial setup
Register or mark those targets without altering overall positioning
Confirm tracked elements and appearance changes are now being monitored
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

contract.name: Begin Stage Setup
contract.description: At the start of a Space Harrier II stage, use this to inspect the opening scene and confirm the level has transitioned into active play, with the previous setup indicator gone and new stage-state objects appearing. Use it right as a new stage begins.

skill.name: Recover/Survive
skill.strategic_description: The survive/recover segment preserves the run while the scene re-stabilizes: the airborne harrier/player representation transitions to a generic visible player, hostile/projectile flight cues disappear, and the HUD/world layout settles into a normal in-play state with score, stage, top score, and lives shown.

steps: Observe instability cues and identify current unsafe transitional state
Choose the nearest viable safe position or stabilizing trajectory
Execute the recovery transition toward the selected safe state
Confirm normal operating cues and standard status indicators returned
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

contract.name: Stay Centered Alive
contract.description: Keep the player near the horizontal center of the playfield and make only small corrections.

contract.name: Dodge Upward
contract.description: Move sharply upward to dodge incoming hazards or enemies lining up with Harrier’s current height. Use it the moment objects appear or shift into your lane, especially during sudden pattern changes or when lower paths close off.
